articles.summary: Ecolab Chairman, President and CEO Christophe Beck joined TBPN to discuss the massive infrastructure buildout underway to support artificial intelligence and the critical role water will play in enabling that growth.
articles.title: Christophe Beck on TBPN: How We Can Scale AI the Right Way

articles.summary: Every year, Global Handwashing Day serves as a reminder that one of the simplest public health practices remains one of the most important. Across workplaces, handwashing moments may be different, but the practice is shared.
articles.title: Handwashing Matters Wherever Work Happens
